description: FIFA 2026 World Cup calendar subscribe/import site. A Python generator merges openfootball fixtures with a TV 2 broadcaster scrape into per-team .ics calendars in Danish time; a daily GitHub Actions cron force-pushes them plus a static picker to GitHub Pages, where users subscribe via webcal:// and the knockout bracket auto-resolves.
install: # Python 3.11+; installs the generator's deps (end users install nothing)
run: # Offline build from fixtures: python scripts/refresh.py --dry-run
